source_warning_review.EXPORT-RASTER: Vector scientific PDF is the manuscript deliverable; 600 dpi embedded fill layers and PNG QA previews are intentional; no journal TIFF submission is requested.

fill_layer_review: Only filled contour maps and colorbar fills are rasterized at 600 dpi. Native final-PDF renders confirm no polygon stitching seams. Surfaces, axes, labels, curves and center trajectories remain vector.
replicate_unit: not applicable: no observations, random sampling, fitted statistics or PDE discretization
normalization: Per-field scales shared between each surface and its map; beta maps share optical scale 0..4. No filtering or exclusions.

qa.manual_review: Accepted after native-PDF full-figure and panel inspection: the twelve fill-edge WARNs are the four tick labels -6, 0, -1 and 1 on each of the three 3D panels a/c/e. The detector compares them with the projected filled-region bounding rectangle; the actual surface is clear of every label. All text-text and text-stroke checks have zero FAIL. The adjacent contour time labels were moved clear before this final export.
